examples.english: if the Loquendo user ELANTICRISTO2007 had a twitter account, he'd be posting his idiocies here. hahaha
examples.ref: 2009 August 5, @SirDeath_MBE, Twitter, archived from the original on 13 Apr 2024:
examples.text: si el loquendero ELANTICRISTO2007 tuviera un twitter, el estaría posteando sus gilipolleses aqui. jajaja
examples.translation: if the Loquendo user ELANTICRISTO2007 had a twitter account, he'd be posting his idiocies here. hahaha

examples.english: In your opinion, who was the best Loquendo user ever on YouTube?

examples.text: Para ustedes, cual fue el mejor loquendero que hubo en Youtube alguna vez?
examples.translation: In your opinion, who was the best Loquendo user ever on YouTube?

examples.english: When I was 9-years-old I wanted to be a Loquendo user
examples.ref: 2023 November 9, @_ramentrash_, Twitter, archived from the original on 14 Mar 2024:
examples.text: cuando tenia 9 años quería ser loquendero
examples.translation: When I was 9-years-old I wanted to be a Loquendo user

examples.english: I'm kind of mediocre as a Loquendo user and gamer in two channels but it entertains me
examples.ref: 2024 March 14, @MecaAndro_XD123, Twitter, archived from the original on 14 Mar 2024:
examples.text: Yo soy medio mediocre como loquendero y gamer en dos canales pero me, me divierte
examples.translation: I'm kind of mediocre as a Loquendo user and gamer in two channels but it entertains me

glosses: An internet user whose videos' voices are made using the speech synthesis software Loquendo.
